title: Canonical order lifecycle vocabulary
resolution: Freeze PENDING_SUBMIT/ACCEPTED/RESTING/PARTIALLY_FILLED/FILLED/CANCEL_PENDING/CANCELED/REJECTED/VENUE_TERMINATED/UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_RECONCILIATION; preserve native status/reason; unknown blocks blind retry.

title: Idempotent submit is not proven by cloid
resolution: Canonical durable requestId is the dedup key. clientOrderId is separate. Native idempotency is only assumed when IDEMPOTENT_SUBMIT is explicitly confirmed; Hyperliquid remains NOT_CONFIRMED. Ambiguous submit => reconcile before resubmit.

title: Trigger / TP-SL capability
resolution: Add neutral TRIGGER_ORDERS capability vocabulary, but do not require/implement it for current PureRSI Hyperliquid v1. TP/SL grouping remains venue-native/deferred.

title: Fee and funding accounting vocabulary
resolution: Add FEE_ACCOUNTING and FUNDING_ACCOUNTING capabilities plus canonical TRADING_FEE/REBATE/FUNDING_PAYMENT signed accounting events.

title: Canonical product / market identity
resolution: Freeze product classes PERPETUAL/SPOT/OUTCOME/OTHER. Canonical market identity requires canonicalAsset + productClass; venue-native locator stays per venue/environment.

title: Batch operation result envelope
resolution: Freeze OPERATION vs ITEM result scope. Whole-operation prevalidation errors must not be fabricated into per-item results.

title: Venue/risk-limit reject taxonomy
resolution: Add canonical VENUE_LIMIT. Local PortfolioRisk rejections remain outside VenueError semantics; native venue reason/code is preserved.

title: Native fill identity
resolution: Adapter constructs opaque stable native_fill_id from venue-sufficient uniqueness. Core never assumes one native field is globally unique.

title: V1 Hyperliquid product scope
resolution: Default perpetuals only are IN_SCOPE for first private adapter. HIP-3 perps and spot are DEFERRED; outcomes OUT_OF_SCOPE. Trigger TP/SL/TWAP deferred; capital movement actions out of scope.
